tools.name: make_static_code
tools.description: Make a QR code without an account. The code holds the content itself (a web address, Wi-Fi login, text, email, phone or SMS), so it works offline and forever, but it can never be changed or counted after printing. Nothing is stored. Returns the image (SVG by default, or PNG).

tools.name: account_status
tools.description: The account this key belongs to: changeable codes used and left, its plans, the plans on sale with prices, and the page where the person buys one.

tools.name: list_codes
tools.description: The account's codes, newest first: id, name, kind, what it holds or where it points, link, status and scans.

tools.name: get_code
tools.description: One code's details, scan stats (per day, countries, devices; automated scans left out) and its recent changes.

tools.name: download_code
tools.description: A print-ready file of one of the account's codes: SVG (default, any size), PNG (up to 2000 px) or vector PDF at a set width in inches.

tools.name: create_code
tools.description: Save a new code in the account. "url" and "vcard" are changeable codes: they hold a short makemyqrcodes.com link, can be pointed somewhere new after printing, count scans, and use the account's allowance. The other types are static and always free. Links are screened before saving. Returns the code'

tools.name: update_code
tools.description: Change where a printed website-link code points, a contact card's details, a code's name or folder, or pause and resume a changeable code. Changing the destination affects everyone who scans it from then on, so confirm with the person first. Codes can't be deleted here.
